facts.value: You are coming from abroad to us? Discover the diverse offerings for international students and researchers at Goethe University and shape your personal academic path.

Studying abroad, participating in an ERASMUS program, internships, or working in research and teaching - a stay abroad opens many new opportunities and perspectives for your personal and professional development.
Goethe University lives internationality: As an international university, it is globally connected and maintains a variety of international university partnerships.
Internationality shapes our research, our degree programs, and our campus. Therefore, all members of Goethe University are international - regardless of their origin.
